hook: Glioblastoma reverts to a fetal glial progenitor-like state, and the gene POU3F3 helps sustain it.
summary: A spatiotemporal multi-omic map of human glioblastoma showed enrichment of a glial intermediate progenitor-like state at tumor core, margin, and recurrence. The lncRNA NRXN1-DT and EGFR mark this state, and POU3F3 regulates them and stem-like properties. No treatment has been tested, and the dataset is limited to the patient samples studied.
title: Glial progenitor-like state is preferentially co-opted in glioblastoma and sustained by POU3F3.
